title: Plan Your Redesign
bottom_line: Run `/design-inspiration:plan` on your mockup or rated shortlist to get an implementation plan in chat. Nothing is written or built.

sections.heading: Run it on your mockup, or on your rated shortlist

blocks.caption: The command. Both parts in brackets are optional.

blocks.title: What the link you give decides

nodes.label: You run plan with a link

blocks.caption: Give it the mockup if you made one. Any other page than a shortlist or mockup made by this plugin: it stops and says so.

blocks.title: Arguments
rows: The newest "<app> Design Mockup" artifact for this repo, else the newest "<app> Design Shortlist" (asks when several match; stops with a pointer to `/design-inspiration:find` when none does)
The mockup you accepted, or the shortlist you rated

blocks.title: The model question
blocks.text: Unless you pass `--model`, it asks "Which model should write the plan?" The options are Opus (first, the default: planning a redesign takes judgment across many files) and Sonnet (cheaper and faster).

blocks.title: The question level
blocks.text: In the same question, always, it asks which design and implementation choices the planner should ask you about, using the `/plan-tools:plan-helper` levels: Everything (every open choice), Balanced (anything you will see or that is costly to undo) or Material only (only choices that change the direction of the work or cannot be cheaply undone).

blocks.title: When to use it
blocks.text: Use it when you have rated a shortlist or finished a mockup and want to apply it: "plan the redesign", "use the designs I picked", "I rated the cards, go", "build the mockup", or when you pass a shortlist or mockup Artifact link, even if you do not say "plan".

sections.heading: You need a rated shortlist or a mockup, and your repo

cards.title: A shortlist or mockup
cards.text: A shortlist from `/design-inspiration:find` with at least one design rated Love, or a mockup from `/design-inspiration:mockup`.

cards.title: Your app's repo
cards.text: Run it from the root of the app's repo, because the planner reads that repo's UI code.

cards.title: plan-tools
cards.text: Installed automatically with the plugin. The plan follows `/plan-tools:plan-helper`.

cards.title: claude.ai Artifact tool
cards.text: To read the shortlist or mockup.

sections.heading: From a shortlist, it plans from your Love cards

steps.title: Reads the page
steps.text: It reads the brief, every app-page section, and your ratings and notes from the page.

steps.title: Checks for a Love card
steps.text: If no design is rated Love, it stops and asks you to rate first. An app page with no Love card is left out of the plan, and the reply names it. A note that plainly ends mid-sentence is not guessed at: it asks you for the full note.

steps.title: Fetches the screenshots
steps.text: It fetches the screenshots of the Love cards and of the Maybe cards you wrote a note on.

steps.title: A planner writes the plan
steps.text: It spawns one planning subagent with the model and question level you chose. The subagent studies the designs (palette, type, spacing, layout, components), reads your app's UI code, and writes one implementation plan for all the rated pages, following `/plan-tools:plan-helper`.

blocks.title: How the plan uses your ratings
items: Love cards lead; a Maybe card contributes only what its note asks for.
It names per change which design it comes from.
It recreates the style in your own code and never reuses the source's images, illustrations or logos.

sections.heading: From a mockup, it plans to build what the mockup shows

steps.title: Checks for open comments
steps.text: Running `plan` on a mockup means you accept it. If a comment thread on the mockup is still open, it stops, lists the open threads with their app page, and asks whether to revise the mockup first or plan anyway.

steps.title: Reads each app page
steps.text: It reads each app page's mockup, its mode (shallow, deep or full redesign) and its listed deliberate changes, and follows the mockup's link back to the shortlist for the brief and the credits of your Love designs. If the shortlist cannot be read, it goes on without it and says so.

steps.title: A planner writes the plan
steps.text: It spawns one planning subagent with the model and question level you chose. The subagent treats the mockup as the target, reads your app's UI code, and plans to build each page in your own code.

cards.title: Revise the mockup first
cards.text: The first option. It stops: run `/design-inspiration:mockup <mockup url>`, then run `/design-inspiration:plan` again.

cards.title: Plan anyway
cards.text: It plans the mockup as it stands. The open comments are not requirements and are named in the final reply.

blocks.title: How the planner builds from the mockup
items: It reuses your existing components and tokens where they give the same look.
It turns the mockup's width breakpoints into your app's media queries.
It wires in the real data in place of the mockup's made-up sample data.
It says plainly where the real result will differ from the mockup.

sections.heading: The choices your question level calls for come back to you

blocks.title: How a design choice is handled

blocks.text: A choice goes into the plan's Decisions only when your notes, brief or answers, the chosen designs, the mockup, or the repo's existing code dictate it. Every other choice is asked if your question level calls for it; the planner makes the rest and lists them under Assumed decisions, never as your decision.
The planner collects those questions and you are asked them together, once, with 2 to 4 options each and a recommendation first.

sections.heading: The plan appears in chat and nothing is built

before.label: You get
before.text: The plan, printed in chat. The reply also names any app page left out for having no Love card, and any open comment left out because you chose to plan anyway.

after.label: Not done
after.text: Nothing is written to the repo, and nothing is implemented.

blocks.title: To build it
blocks.text: Hand the plan to `/plan-tools:plan-implement-complete` or implement it yourself.

sections.heading: Most stops have a one-step fix

cards.title: No Love card
cards.text: If no design is rated Love, it stops.

points.text: Rate at least one design Love on the shortlist, then run it again.

cards.title: Open comments on the mockup
cards.text: It stops and lists the open threads.

points.text: Choose "Revise the mockup first" or "Plan anyway".

cards.title: No shortlist or mockup found
cards.text: With no link and no matching artifact for this repo, it stops.

cards.title: A page that is neither
cards.text: It stops and says it needs a shortlist or a mockup made by this plugin.

next_action.text: From your app's repo root, run `/design-inspiration:plan` with your mockup's link, or your rated shortlist's link if you made no mockup.
next_action.detail: The shortlist needs at least one design rated Love.
